spec.name: Logo减红薄纸层v03
spec.prompt:
Refine the supplied game logo with carefully edited color hierarchy and thin paper construction. User feedback: 颜色太鲜艳，红色太多，logo还需要优化. Produce a professionally balanced, quieter version, preserving EXACT title 交子赶工记, the rounded friendly brush typography and the two-line 交子 / 赶工记 arrangement, small note+coin upper-left, small cloud right, little seal right. Keep natural wordmark aspect ratio centered on SQUARE 1:1 true transparent-alpha canvas.
IMPORTANT meaningful changes:
1. Letters become a subdued WARM BRICK/IRON-OXIDE RED, target #AA543E; remove blazing orange, tomato neon and hot orange-red gradients. Still richly readable and warm, not dusty grey.
2. Large bright yellow and golden backing masses become WARM IVORY #F1E2C6. Eliminate the multiple thick gold rings. Use just ONE narrow creamy outline and ONE slim muted bronze/tan paper offset. No yellow glow. Reduce visible edge-stack thickness by about two-thirds. Logo should feel cut from two or three thin pieces of card, not a thick plastic cookie.
3. Teal perimeter becomes a NARROW muted GREY-SAGE line #6B8278, at most 1% of overall logo width; stop the thick turquoise bumper around everything. Dark shadows subtle and very short, not black/brown extrusion. Keep interior gaps clear rather than filled with deep dark shadow.
4. Improve typographic rhythm: equal optical spacing and breathing room between the lower 赶 工 记, all strokes complete, avoid one giant sweeping stroke swallowing the next letter. Do not substitute characters. Rounded confident brush endings, no pointed polygon cuts or origami facets inside the lettering.
5. Supporting note and coin are modest and clear: ONE ivory historical note with simple slate-grey thin border, bronze square-hole coin behind it, smaller so they do not compete with 交. Cloud is only a small quiet ivory curved paper form, little seal muted cinnabar. No added props, words, animals, people, background or decorative noise.
Shape and paper style cohesive with a calm Song papermill counter menu using natural warm wood, ivory and grey-sage. Focus is legible five-character title, not yellow scalloped backing. No embossed gloss, fuzzy brush texture, grain speckles, dirty cracks, noisy fabric, stickers piled around title. Subtle paper tooth only.
Background completely transparent; no cream square, no checkerboard baked in, no fake transparent white. Keep logo natural wide silhouette inside square with comfortable transparent top/bottom padding, at least 6% padding at left/right. This is targeted quality refinement of the supplied logo, not a new brand or generic text-only wordmark.
